concepts.gloss_en: The manna (lechem min hashamayim), associated with da'at/knowledge
Oil (shemen); linked to David's malchut, the seven lamps, and moisture rising to the brain — NOT manna

members.note: Distinct word 'oil'; not a he/prefix variant of מן. Own concept.

concepts.gloss_en: Haman the wicked (pride/ga'avut, malchut of the sitra achra, idolatry) — a proper name, NOT 'the manna'

members.note: Proof quotes show Haman (ga'avut, avodah zarah), not ha+man. Distinct concept.

notes: The mechanical clitic/he-prefix signals are false positives. מן (manna), שמן (oil), and המן (Haman) are three unrelated lexemes that merely share consonants. No merging — three fully distinct concepts.
